title: Sparky Stereo OS 9 "Mashtabba": the stereo 3D edition of SparkyLinux
description: Sparky Stereo OS 9 "Mashtabba" is Daniel Ramos's edition of SparkyLinux (by Paweł "pavroo" Pijanowski), based on Debian 14 "Forky", with KDE Plasma only: a desktop where stereo 3D is part of the system, from the graphics driver to the display, with the deepest colour the screen accepts. This is a development snapshot. Documents under CC BY 4.0; scripts and tools under GPL-2.0-or-later.
